headline: Nevish Line Still Leads as Fronts Re-sort
war_summary: The latest ledger shows Nevish Line still foremost in the campaign, though its 70 events in 24 hours are down from 74 in the previous edition; five came in the latest two-hour watch, and ownership now reads seven Warden bases to one Colonial. Weathered Expanse likewise eased to 48 events from 51, but four were fresh, with seven Warden, two neutral, and no Colonial bases recorded. Marban Hollow has plainly quickened, producing four events in two hours against two previously; its frontier now stands six Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral. Linn Mercy’s activity has thinned to 13 daily events, yet six arrived during the last six hours, while its ledger shows ten Colonial and one neutral base. Kuura Strand remains lively in the full-day account at 17 events but has gone quiet across the latest six hours. Elsewhere, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle retain heavy casualty traffic with limited recent base movement, while Callahan’s Passage and Mooring County are seeing sharply accelerating losses without recorded ownership events. The chief risks for the next watch remain concentrated in the divided, recently active sectors.
